Name: No Qi Required
Author: cosplaywrite
Description:
Are you sick of doing endless Qi Challenges to grind for Qi Gems you can spend on things you really want? Grind no more!

With No Qi Required, you can obtain many of the items (Key to the Town and Galaxy Soul are excluded) from the Walnut Room by other means.

In order to bypass Qi entirely, this mod does the following:

[spoiler]Adds crafting recipes for the mushroom tree seed, enricher, pressure nozzle, deconstructor, and a way to transmute gold bars into iridium bars and iridium bars into radioactive bars.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Adds rules to the deconstructor to break down bars smelted from ore into half their component ore (including radioactive bars).[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Adds special orders for multiple characters to lead to obtaining crafting recipes for the enricher, pressure nozzle, deconstructor, mushroom tree seed, magic bait, heavy tapper, hyper speed-gro, deluxe fertilizer and hopper. 1.1.0 adds a special order for the blue grass starter.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Adds a special order to get the horse flute.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Adds the aquatic sanctuary, exotic double bed, and junimo chest to Robin's shop, Qi Seasoning to the saloon's inventory, and Hat Mouse may have even stolen a hat from a certain blue gentleman to sell in his shop.[/spoiler]
